institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: R-mini-CHOP (attenuated R-CHOP for the frail/elderly)

premedications.name: Pre-phase steroid
premedications.notes: consider a short prednisone pre-phase to improve performance status before cycle 1

supportiveCare: G-CSF support (higher febrile-neutropenia risk in the elderly)
PJP + antiviral prophylaxis; hepatitis B screen
Careful attention to hydration, renal function and drug interactions in older patients
monitoring: LVEF at baseline and cardiac monitoring (reduced-dose anthracycline chosen for limited reserve)
Geriatric assessment; reassess tolerance each cycle

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Attenuated 400 mg/m2 IV day 1 (about half of standard R-CHOP).

drugs.name: Doxorubicin
drugs.notes: Attenuated 25 mg/m2 IV day 1 (about half of standard) to limit cardiotoxicity.
